note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026), Bulgaria, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahwealj992) and average post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, in BGN of that year, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. BGN has since been replaced by EUR: the figures are carried into EUR at the issuer's fixed rate, 1.95583 BGN to one EUR, the Council of the European Union's conversion rate of 8 July 2025, 1.95583 leva to the euro, as the European Central Bank's press release of that day states it. Read 2026-10-30.
